purpose: An unquoted `key=` expression that starts with a digit is refused in an HSPICE deck.

oracle.derivation: Star-Hspice Manual, Release 1998.2, ch. 3 (class.ece.uw.edu/cadta/hspice/chapter_3.pdf) p. 3-21: "Expressions are delimited by single or double quotes"; HSPICE Quick Reference Guide U-2003.03 (cse.chalmers.se/~perla/ugrad/EDA351/HSPICEQuickRef.pdf), .PARAM: "Quotes around the algebraic expression are mandatory". 2*rv is unquoted and is not a name (names begin with an alphabetic character, p. 3-18), so the card fails. ngspice-44.2 and 45 fail it too ("unknown parameter (*)").
oracle.confirmed_reason: No second simulator reads the HSPICE dialect: Xyce -hspice-ext is Xyce's own extension, not HSPICE; the manuals are the oracle.
